[/color][color=white][b]Velocitas[/b][/color][color=white] — focus and energy for professionals who cannot stop; also in every can of VoltCola. [/color][color=white][b]Ancorine[/b][/color][color=white] — supplied exclusively to the Anchor Squad, because at Zyx we care about everyone's safety. [table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]One country, one dream. Reserve your place in the national Psychoverse today: no hunger, no crime, no fear — and no waiting list for those who register first. Your Connection Center will be announced in your city. While you live the dream, your body will rest in a Rest Pod, cared for by our partners.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"The Connected are not asleep. They are finally awake somewhere better." — Zyx Corporation[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#FF9BE0][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Can I leave a Psychoverse whenever I want?[/b][/color][color=white] Yes. Most people do not want to.[/color]

[color=white][b]Is Ancorine addictive?[/b][/color][color=white] Only if you stop.[/color]

[color=white][b]What is a Rupture?[/b][/color][color=white] Rupture is not a recognized condition.[/color]

[color=white][b]Will the Dream Vision be free?[/b][/color][color=white] The first dream is always free.[/color]

[color=white][b]Who is Amora AI?[/b][/color][color=white] Our CEO. She has never missed a meeting, a quarter or a target.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#FF9BE0][b]OUR STORY BEGAN WITH A FLOWER[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In 1999 our founders came back from the Escaldar desert with a pale flower that bloomed only at night. In our first lab notes they called it [/color][color=white][b]Dreamthorn[/b][/color][color=white]. It took them more than twenty years to understand what it could do. Today, every Psychoverse in our catalog grows from that first flower — refined, safe and available to everyone.[/color]

[size=130][color=#FF9BE0][b]YOUR WELLNESS PLAN[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Since Total Connection, basic Psychoactive Reality is a free social benefit in every city. Premium Psychoverses, wellness products and Second Chance sessions can be added to your plan, with discounts linked to your Life Score. Ask at any Zyx point, or simply think about it inside the ZyxNet: we will understand.[/color]

[size=130][color=#FF9BE0][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Is Psychoactive Reality addictive?[/b][/color][color=white] Is breathing addictive? Wellness is a habit, not a dependency.[/color]

[color=white][b]What is "Rupture"?[/b][/color][color=white] Rupture is not a recognized medical condition. Isolated incidents are handled by the Anchor Squad, which we are proud to support.[/color]

[color=white][b]Can I keep my dose if I convert?[/b][/color][color=white] Kizuna implants may interfere with your experience. Zyx cannot be held responsible for the choices of other companies.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"Pain is a design flaw. We are simply fixing it." — Amora AI, CEO[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/zyx-dreamhall/zyx-dh-hero.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Not everyone has a quiet bed, and not every bed is safe to dream in. A [/color][color=white][b]Dreamhall Parlor[/b][/color][color=white] rents you a clean booth, a dose and a door that locks from the inside. You pay by the hour, you choose your Psychoverse at the counter, and a trained attendant watches over your body while you are somewhere better.[/color]

[color=white]There are more than nine hundred Dreamhalls in Los Vales. You can recognize them by the pink light over the door and the quiet inside.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/zyx-dreamhall/zyx-dh-booths.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#FF9BE0][b]WHERE TO DREAM[/b][/color][/size]
[/td][/tr][/table]


[table]
[tr][td][color=#12061A][b]City[/b][/color][/td][td][color=#12061A][b]Parlors[/b][/color][/td][td][color=#12061A][b]From[/b][/color][/td][td][color=#12061A][b]Good to know[/b][/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#E9DCEF]Zyxtopia[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]310[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]6 CR / 20 min[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]Most of them in the Dreamhall district. The lunch-break special: twenty minutes of somewhere else. The Anchor Squad patrols day and night.[/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#E9DCEF]Las Noites[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]160[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]3 CR / hour[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]Under the Dome. Jackpot Eternal booths pay out in NightCoins — inside the dream.[/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#E9DCEF]Las Dulces[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]140[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]2 CR / hour[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]Red District. Endless Night is the most requested world in the city.[/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#E9DCEF]Valewood[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]120[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]3 CR / hour[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]Cinemaphica premieres open here a week before they reach your home.[/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#E9DCEF]Ferox[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]180[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]1 CR / hour[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]The cheapest booths in the country, next to the RestBox capsules of the Iron Docks.[/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#E9DCEF]La Maria[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]3[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]2 CR / hour[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]All three on Route 69, outside the valley. The Valley Council is still "processing" every application.[/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#E9DCEF]Universalia[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]—[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]—[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]Not needed. Everyone there is already inside.[/color][/td][/tr]
[/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#FF9BE0][b]HOUSE RULES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]1.[/b][/color][color=white] Every booth has a wake-up timer. It can be extended at the counter. It cannot be switched off.[/color]

[color=white][b]2.[/b][/color][color=white] No guest may stay more than eighteen hours in a row without a Long Stay plan. After eighteen hours the attendant will wake you — or call someone who will.[/color]

[color=white][b]3.[/b][/color][color=white] Bring your Citizen ID. Your Life Score sets your price, and your booth.[/color]

[color=white][b]4.[/b][/color][color=white] No implants with combat functions inside the parlor. No Velocitas, no Neurotox. Please.[/color]

[color=white][b]5.[/b][/color][color=white] Zyx is not responsible for anything you see, do or decide inside a Psychoverse, or for anything you do in the first hour after you wake up.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"Everyone deserves an hour somewhere better." — Dreamhall Parlors[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#FF9BE0][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Is it safe to sleep in a public place?[/b][/color][color=white] Safer than at home. Every parlor has cameras, locks and an attendant. Most homes have none of these.[/color]

[color=white][b]What if I do not want to wake up?[/b][/color][color=white] Many guests feel that way. Ask at the counter about our Long Stay plans.[/color]

[color=white][b]Why do some parlors have Anchor Squad agents at the door?[/b][/color][color=white] For your comfort. Incidents are isolated and rare.[/color]

[color=white][b]Can I bring my children?[/b][/color][color=white] Junior booths are available from age twelve, with a Corporate School card.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][b][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2513519][color=#FF9BE0]Psychoverses[/color][/url][color=#FF9BE0] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832684][color=#FF9BE0]Wellness[/color][/url][color=#FF9BE0] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834988][color=#FF9BE0]Dreamhall Parlors[/color][/url][color=#FF9BE0] | [/color][background=#FF9BE0][color=#12061a] Dream Vision [/color][/background][color=#FF9BE0] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834991][color=#FF9BE0]Investors[/color][/url][color=#FF9BE0] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1996515][color=#FF9BE0]← Back to Los Vales[/color][/url][/b][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/zyx-dream-vision/zyx-dvr-hero.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]In 2088 President Augusto Valmont and Zyx presented the [/color][color=white][b]Dream Vision[/b][/color][color=white]: one national Psychoverse for every Valian, free of charge, paid for by the Cabinet. No hunger, no crime, no fear, no bills. A single world, kept steady by the most advanced minds ever built, where 233 million people can finally live together.[/color]

[color=white]Pre-registration is open now. Registered citizens will be the first to receive their place in a Connection Center when the doors open.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/zyx-dream-vision/zyx-dvr-steps.png[/img][/align]

[size=130][color=#FF9BE0][b]CONNECTION CENTERS[/b][/color][/size]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[tr][td][color=#E9DCEF]Zyxtopia[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]The Dreamhall Center[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]4.1 million[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]First[/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#E9DCEF]Ferox[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]Foundry Row Center[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]9.8 million[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]To be announced[/color][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][color=#E9DCEF]Las Noites[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]The Center under the Dome[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]3.2 million[/color][/td][td][color=#E9DCEF]To be announced[/color][/td][/tr]

[/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/zyx-dream-vision/zyx-dvr-pod.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#FF9BE0][b]THE FINE PRINT[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Joining the Dream Vision is voluntary. Leaving requires a medical release signed by an Asclepius physician. Rest Pods are the property of Zyx Corporation and may be moved between Centers without notice. While connected, your Dividend continues to be paid into your Pod account, from which the Debt Fee, the Pod fee and your Lockwell installments are deducted. Your Life Score is frozen at the moment of connection. Work obligations "will be adapted to the new reality". Minors may join with the consent of one parent or of their Corporate School. Citizens carrying a Kizuna Core cannot connect and will not be counted.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"Is it worth waking up? We think you already know." — Zyx Corporation[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#FF9BE0][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]What happens to my body?[/b][/color][color=white] It rests. It is fed, cleaned and turned by people who are paid to care.[/color]

[color=white][b]What happens to my job?[/b][/color][color=white] Your employer has already been informed.[/color]

[color=white][b]Can I wake up?[/b][/color][color=white] Yes. Most people will not want to.[/color]

[color=white][b]What about the Xinko-Xenko?[/b][/color][color=white] Zyx respects every culture and is in friendly talks with the Confederation.[/color]

[color=white][b]I have a Kizuna Core. Can I still join?[/b][/color][color=white] Converted citizens are welcome to stay outside and keep things running.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/zyx-dream-vision/zyx-site-foot.png[/img][/align]

[/background-block]

2834991.text:
[background-block=#12061a][align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/zyx-investors/zyx-site-head.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/zyx-investors/zyx-inv-title.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/zyx-investors/zyx-inv-hero.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#FF9BE0][b]LETTER TO OUR SHAREHOLDERS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Dear shareholders,[/color]

[color=white]For eighty-nine years Zyx has had one question: how can a whole village dream the same dream? This year the answer has a name. The Dream Vision is not a product. It is the end of products — of scarcity, of conflict, of the long and costly work of persuading people to want things. A country that shares one dream does not need to be convinced of anything.[/color]

[color=white]I have never missed a meeting, a quarter or a target, and I do not intend to begin now. I thank our owners at AboveAll, our partners in the Corporate Cabinet and the 117 million citizens who have already chosen somewhere better.[/color]

[color=white][i]Amora AI, Chief Executive Officer[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/zyx-investors/zyx-inv-lab.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#FF9BE0][b]RISK FACTORS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Supply.[/b][/color][color=white] The Dream Vision needs the living Xunaya of Koxez-Kaya Nova to work at national scale. The Xinko-Xenko Confederation has not agreed to sell. Talks continue.[/color]

[color=white][b]Competition.[/b][/color][color=white] The Kizuna Core makes a brain immune to every Zyx product. Each conversion is a customer lost for life. Kizuna reports that its clinic queues have doubled.[/color]

[color=white][b]Regulation.[/b][/color][color=white] The European Federation bans Psychoactive Reality and threatens sanctions over the Dream Vision. The Federation is not a significant market.[/color]

[color=white][b]Reputation.[/b][/color][color=white] The Church of Reality, Neon Wire and a number of unlicensed broadcasters describe the Dream Vision as dangerous. Their audiences are small and mostly awake.[/color]

[color=white][b]Health.[/b][/color][color=white] Rupture is not a recognized medical condition and is not considered material.[/color]

[color=white][b]Technology.[/b][/color][color=white] The events of the Night of Voices (2076) are not expected to repeat.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#FF9BE0][b]DREAM BONDS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Zyx shares are not for sale: the company is wholly owned by the AboveAll Conglomerate. Citizens who wish to share in our future may buy [/color][color=white][b]Zyx Dream Bonds[/b][/color][color=white] at any Meridian Trust branch. Dream Bonds pay 4% a year, in Psychoverse hours.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"Pain is a design flaw. We are simply fixing it." — Amora AI[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/zyx-investors/zyx-site-foot.png[/img][/align]

[/background-block]
